title: Deliver Maize to Tontway Food Processing Plant
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Maize** delivered to **Tontway Food Processing Plant** (industry id 3, near tile 78,73).

A likely supplier is **Tontway Farm** (industry id 11, near tile 73,93); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **350 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
